price_series: daily common-stock OHLC; use Close consistently; adjustment convention must be declared and consistent
estimator: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) over exactly N consecutive valid close-to-close log returns
missing_session_policy: Reject the window unless all expected exchange sessions in that exact window are represented once; do not forward-fill, interpolate, or bridge unknown gaps. Exchange holiday calendar must be independently verified.
date_policy: Strictly increasing unique ISO dates, no future observation relative to declared calculation date.
ohlc_quality: All OHLC finite and positive; Low <= Open/Close <= High.
corporate_actions: Single explicit convention across the window: RAW_UNADJUSTED, SPLIT_ADJUSTED, or SPLIT_AND_DIVIDEND_ADJUSTED. Reject UNKNOWN or inconsistent series.
minimum_sample: N valid returns; sample SD requires N >= 2.
rounding: Keep full floating-point result in calculation audit; UI may display two decimal places only after a verified production calculation.
calculation_date: Latest eligible source close date, not system time.
current_source_status: No eligible NVDA OHLC dataset found; no production HV value emitted.
